description: This source file defines the FloatingRateData class, which is a data transfer object used to represent floating rate information in the Fineract system. It holds properties such as id, name, rate periods, and interest rate options, and includes comparison and equality logic.

classes.name: FloatingRateData
classes.description: A data object representing floating rate configuration, including identification, status, creation and modification info, rate periods, and interest rate options.

methods.description: Implements comparison logic based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive to allow sorting of floating rate data objects.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive to determine object equivalence.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on id, name, isBaseLendingRate, and isActive.
